verdict_statement: Valid operating point established on 24 stratified real images x 24 real object prompts at threshold 0.5 (median mask area 5.1053% >= 1.0%, kept median area 9.463%, median score +0.5271 > 0, detection rate 84.5%). At this operating point, documented variants have cross-image IoU median 0.0 (unconditional top-query 0.0), confirming absence of an input-independent fixed-mask branch. Capacity controls A (IoU=1.0) and B (within-family IoU=1.0) both pass.
